description: The plot illustrates the relationship between Co-occurrence Number and ACC (%) for various models, including Base, FT, IKE, MEND, MEMIT, and ROME. The x-axis is labeled "Co-occurrence Number" with a logarithmic scale, ranging from approximately 3 to 3000, with tick labels at 10^0, 10^1, 10^2, and 10^3. The y-axis is labeled "ACC (%)" with a linear scale, ranging from 60 to 80, with tick labels at intervals of 5. The Base model is represented by a black solid line with circle markers, increasing from around 61 at a Co-occurrence Number of 3 to approximately 67 at 3000. The FT model is depicted by a blue solid line with diamond markers, rising from about 62 at 3 to roughly 69 at 3000. The IKE model is shown as a red solid line with upward triangle markers, growing from around 63 at 3 to approximately 71 at 3000. The MEND model is represented by a brown dashed line with diamond markers, increasing from about 65 at 3 to roughly 75 at 3000. The MEMIT model is illustrated by a purple dashed line with downward triangle markers, rising from around 64 at 3 to approximately 73 at 3000. The ROME model is depicted by a green dashed line with square markers, increasing from about 72 at 3 to roughly 78 at 3000, before leveling off. All lines exhibit an overall upward trend as Co-occurrence Number increases.
